sn52.3:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā anuruddho sāvatthiyaṃ viharati sutanutīre.
sn52.3:1.2: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yenāyasmā anuruddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā anuruddhena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu
sn52.3:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn52.3:1.4: katamesaṃ āyasmā anuruddho dhammānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññattaṃ pattoti.
sn52.3:2.1: catunnaṃ khvāhaṃ āvuso satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññattaṃ patto.
sn52.3:2.3: idhāvuso kāye kāyānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.3:2.6: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.3:2.7: imesaṃ khvāhaṃ āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññattaṃ patto.
sn52.3:2.8: imesañca panāhaṃ āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā hīnaṃ dhammaṃ hīnato abbhaññāsiṃ majjhimaṃ dhammaṃ majjhimato abbhaññāsiṃ paṇītaṃ dhammaṃ paṇītato abbhaññāsinti.
